details:
I would really love if there were a few chatbox sounds to pick from (like 5-10 or so built-in) that you could choose to be "your chatbox sound" to allow people to be more attentive about who is sending a message and let mutes express themselves further. Sort of how people use different text to speech voices. (Or have real voices, I guess. lol)

There would obviously still be overlap in who uses which sound, but I feel like this is negligible for most friend groups as entire social situations generally aren't mute. As long as there are a decent selection of 5-10 sounds to pick from, I think this would be a fantastic addition and would make chatbox users in VRChat very happy.

Perhaps uploading additional custom (max 1-2 seconds long) sounds alongside the base few could be a VRC+ feature and could expand the ability to present yourself uniquely? (I feel like I should clarify, if this were to become a thing, please don't make the ability to pick chatbox sounds within itself a VRC+ feature. Just the ability to upload custom ones. I don't want accessibility features behind paywalls.)

To recap, I would like to be able to assign **my own** notification sound, not let people assign sounds for me. We should have control over how we are presented.

If this idea is out of scope, please at least consider adding a different noise for chat messages sent by friends VS non-friends.
title: Assigning unique chatbox notification sounds to yourself as a form of expression/differentiation
